subject: School District Capital Plan
overview: The subcommittee reviewed and updated the school district's multi-year capital plan, prioritizing urgent facility needs and funding mechanisms for FY25 and FY26. The committee voted to recommend the revised capital plan to the full School Committee.

items.title: McGlynn and Andrews School Capital Bundling
items.summary: The subcommittee reviewed bundled HVAC, roof reconstruction, and network closet work at the McGlynn and Andrews schools, noting that city bonding must proceed in January to ensure construction finishes before the next school year.

items.title: MSBA Accelerated Repair and Electrification Assessments
items.summary: Members discussed funding a mini-assessment to prepare an application for the MSBA Accelerated Repair Program for roofs and HVAC at older elementary schools, while coordinating future electrification assessments with the city's Green Communities initiative.

items.title: FY25 and FY26 Capital Project Priorities
items.summary: The committee reviewed estimates for urgent capital needs, designating network closet mini-splits, elevator motor repairs, Brooks drainage, key fob access systems, and ADA entrance ramp grant submissions as recommended priorities.

items.title: Elementary Playground Prioritization
items.summary: The committee discussed future Community Preservation Act applications, prioritizing the Roberts Elementary playground while examining severe space limitations, parking constraints, and potential property expansion needs.

items.title: Capital Plan Recommendation to School Committee
items.summary: Approved a motion recommending the updated capital plan and project priorities to the full School Committee.
